notes.title: Screamer Preview — Cel Shaded Car Carnage
notes.notes:
Despite its pre-Alpha state, Screamer is shaping up to be the kind of atypical racing experience I look for in a genre I otherwise ignore.

When it comes to racing games, I tend to like arcade-inspired racers that forgo realism for fun. Sadly, most non-traditional racers tend to veer towards the kart racer genre, which I’m a fan of, but sometimes, you want something different, and Screamer itches that itch with its anime-inspired roster and unique battle mechanics that set it apart from others.

The early access build of Screamer consists of 9 playable characters and 9 playable race tracks or courses. For the playable characters, Screamer separates them into two camps, Members and Leaders, with the former having the bulk of your playable racers, with 4 distinct characters, while Leaders currently sits at 3. There doesn’t seem to be a whole lot different between the Leaders and Members, with each character featuring a unique ability on top of the standard boost,... Read more

notes.title: SCREAMER - MEET THE GREEN REAPERS!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343553/122514cc639e3eb85dbb6b1f5a0b6078eaf8b8d7.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello, Screamers![/p][p]It's time to meet the first team in the Tournament. Allow us to introduce you to the Green Reapers.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ohg98Y1a5ko;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Don’t let the appearances of these three fool you – there's more to them than meets the eye. As former private military contractors with different backgrounds but common experience in high-risk operations, they teamed thanks to Quinn Connolly, their leader and mentor, who saw them as diamonds in the rough and gave them a second chance. Unfortunately, she was involved in a tragic accident that changed the team’s life forever, pushing them to sign up for the Tournament and seek revenge for her death.[/p][p]
[b]Hiroshi Jackson[/b], the team leader, is intense – Quinn’s death weighs heavily on his shoulders. He is not alone on this journey for vengeance; with him are [b]Frederic Barthelemy[/b], a hothead in constant search of new thrills, and [b]Róisín Garrity[/b], a deadly assassin trained to kill from a young age.[/p][p]
Though they are lacking in experience on the track, they're no strangers to chaos and survival. The Tournament is their opportunity to close a chapter of their lives, finally putting their anger and suffering to rest.[/p][p]
In the next months, we will reveal the other teams, so stay tuned to find out more![/p]

notes.title: SCREAMER - Discover the official key art!
notes.notes:
[p]Attention, Screamers! We can finally share the official key art for Screamer, created in collaboration with Polygon Pictures.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343553/3fc0f9b6766a7b86b80ed3ebf134342b3807fcad.png"][/img][/p][p]Take a sneak peek at some of the protagonists of the game, while the streets of Neo Rey frame an intense, adrenaline-fueled Tournament race.[/p][p]This key art perfectly encapsulates the many facets of Screamer: from the narrative to the high-octane gameplay, you’ll enjoy a unique and unforgettable gaming experience.[/p][p]
We know you can’t wait to learn more about the characters, which is why we have a little surprise for you. In the thrilling races of the Tournament, you won’t drive alone, but rather in a team. In Screamer, you will learn the stories of the five participating teams, and very soon you’ll be able to meet them.[/p][p]Over the next few months, we will reveal every team that will embark on an all-hands-on-deck journey, starting with the Green Reapers. Stay tuned so you don’t miss any updates![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343553/bd069842d4e345f54bf73c77f02f756410fb4fb8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Screamer will be released in 2026.[/p]

notes.title: SCREAMER – Gameplay Reveal
notes.notes: [p]Welcome Screamers![/p][p]The Tournament has not yet commenced, but we can finally share the first gameplay trailer which unveils some of the key mechanics of the game.[/p][p]Dive deep into the dark atmosphere of Neo Rey, one of the stunning sceneries that you will be able to explore in Screamer and follow the thrilling race taking place in the city streets.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="BCiHWV8Ieig;full"][/previewyoutube][p]In Screamer, you can boost your way to victory with the [b]ECHO[/b], a unique device that completely changes the game rules. This mysterious technology allows you to deploy a set of game mechanics that will help you survive in the Tournament, where speed alone is not enough to reach glory.[/p][p]You will be able to handle every vehicle through a [b]Twin Stick[/b] control scheme: you will use the left analog stick to steer and the right one to drift. This precise driving tool will give you a satisfying experience when cornering and fighting opponents. But that’s not all, there will also be perks for you to use during the races. The [b]Boost[/b] will push your car to its limit, and the [b]Strike[/b], which must be used carefully and strategically, will allow you to take out your opponents if hit at the right moment. Lastly, the [b]Overdrive[/b] is a powerful tool that will help you wreak chaotic havoc on the racetracks.[/p][p]We are seeing the first competitors arriving at the Tournament. Who are they? What was it that made them accept the challenge? Stay tuned to find out more![/p]
